paragraphs.text: Sarixa is part of the Cocobar Islands , an archipelago in the Sea of Serenity south of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria .

Around 3336 AR , Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries came to the Cocobars to collect powerstones . In Sarixa, they recruited a guide named Steppan , an old, almost blind fisherman who was the only one to dare sail to the haunted island of Koltos .
